  "sql": "WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY), '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED) AS start_dt,
        CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED) AS end_dt
),
daily_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        dt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'ServerPayLog' THEN CAST(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(`personal`, '$.money')), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) ELSE 0 END) AS recharge_sum,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event = 'UserActive' THEN uid END) AS active_users,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event = 'ServerPayLog' THEN uid END) AS paying_users
    FROM `event`
    WHERE dt BETWEEN (SELECT start_dt FROM bounds) AND (SELECT end_dt FROM bounds)
      AND event IN ('ServerPayLog', 'UserActive')
    GROUP BY dt
)
SELECT 
    STR_TO_DATE(CAST(dt AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') AS `日期`,
    ROUND(recharge_sum / NULLIF(active_users, 0), 2) AS `arpu`,
    ROUND(recharge_sum / NULLIF(paying_users, 0), 2) AS `arppu`
FROM daily_metrics
ORDER BY dt
LIMIT 1000;",

    SELECT 
        CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED) AS start_dt,
        CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED) AS end_dt
),
daily_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        e.dt AS stat_dt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN e.event = 'ServerPayLog' THEN CAST(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.personal, '$.money')), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) ELSE 0 END) AS total_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event = 'UserActive' THEN e.uid END) AS active_users,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event = 'ServerPayLog' THEN e.uid END) AS paying_users
    FROM `event` e
    JOIN bounds b ON e.dt BETWEEN b.start_dt AND b.end_dt
    WHERE e.event IN ('ServerPayLog', 'UserActive')
    GROUP BY e.dt
)
SELECT 
    STR_TO_DATE(CAST(stat_dt AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') AS `日期`,
    ROUND(total_revenue, 2) AS `后端充值总额`,
    active_users AS `当日活跃用户数`,
    paying_users AS `当日付费用户数`,
    ROUND(total_revenue / NULLIF(active_users, 0), 2) AS `ARPU`,
    ROUND(total_revenue / NULLIF(paying_users, 0), 2) AS `ARPPU`
FROM daily_stats
ORDER BY stat_dt",
